english.note: Use 咖啡 as the all-purpose noun for the beverage or a serving of it.
Use this when English mud refers to coffee in slang or an informal context.

examples.english: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 tung1 soeng4 jam2 gaa3 fe1

examples.english: I need a cup of mud every morning, or I won't have the energy to work.
examples.traditional: 我朝早一定要飲杯咖啡，唔係冇精神返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 jat1 ding6 jiu3 jam2 bui1 gaa3 fe1 m4 hai6 mou5 zing1 san4 faan1 gung1
